_format: skill-creator eval format. Run each prompt in a fresh session with and without the skill; grade the assertions. expect_trigger false marks a should-not-trigger probe.

evals.prompt: We hebben net een bedrijfspagina op LinkedIn aangemaakt. Is het beter om onze lanceringspost daarop te zetten en hem dan vanaf mijn eigen profiel te delen, of andersom?
assertions: Recommends the original on the personal profile, and names the mechanism: a page post is first tested against roughly 2 to 5 percent of followers while a personal post seeds to first-degree connections

Rejects the repost route specifically, with the numbers: an instant repost lifts the original about 4 percent and does nothing for the reposter, and a repost-with-thoughts under 100 own words underperforms 3x
Still gives the page a role (its own native post, commented on from the personal profile; mention the page from the personal post) rather than dismissing it

evals.prompt: Ik zet de aanmeldlink altijd in de eerste reactie in plaats van in de post zelf, want dat scheelt bereik. Klopt dat nog?
assertions: States plainly that the first-comment workaround has been penalised since early 2026 and is no longer a way around the penalty
Gives the body-link cost as roughly 18.8 percent median reach, attributed to van der Blom's Algorithm Insights over 1.3 million posts
Makes the decision depend on the post's goal rather than giving a blanket rule: keep the link when sign-ups are the metric, drop every URL when conversation is the metric
Mentions that a bare domain also counts as a link

evals.prompt: Ik heb mijn post in het LinkedIn-venster geplakt en nu staat alles aan elkaar geplakt tot één blok. Kan ik de kopjes vet maken zodat het leesbaar wordt?
assertions: Explains that the editor collapses consecutive newlines on paste while single newlines survive, so the layout must not depend on blank lines
Proposes a visible separator line between sections instead, and keeping paragraphs to three lines or fewer
Advises against Unicode pseudo-bold and gives the accessibility reason: a screen reader announces the characters one at a time as mathematical bold letters
Offers the accessible alternative: an emoji plus a short ALL-CAPS label on its own line, used a handful of times at most

evals.prompt: Schrijf een LinkedIn-post waarin we sprekers zoeken voor onze nieuwe maandelijkse tech-avond, en zeg erbij wanneer ik hem moet plaatsen.
assertions: Loads or explicitly defers to the humanize skill for the prose, and the draft contains no em dash and no not-X-but-Y construction
The draft carries exactly one ask, answerable in one word, rather than stacking several requests
Length lands in the 800 to 1500 character band, or the reply justifies going longer because it is a launch post
Names a posting window of Tuesday to Thursday, 08:00 to 10:00, and says to stay available for the first hour because that decides distribution
Uses at most three hashtags, at the end

evals.prompt: Onze nieuwsbrief in Brevo komt bij Gmail in de spam terecht. Waar moet ik beginnen met zoeken?
assertions: Does not invoke the linkedin-post skill or bring up LinkedIn reach mechanics
Answers about mail authentication and deliverability instead
